applies_to.quote: These Directions shall be applicable to Urban Co-operative Banks (hereinafter collectively referred to as ‘UCBs’ and individually as a ‘UCB’).

answer.action: Urban Co-operative Banks must implement the concurrent audit system, conduct annual reviews, and ensure compliance with reporting and audit governance instructions.
answer.action_quote: It is, therefore, necessary for the Urban Co- operative Banks (UCBs) management to bestow serious attention to the implementation of various aspects of the system

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into effect immediately upon issuance.
